english: Is that the sound of higurashi...?\nEarly summer in Japan-\nthe season must be June, I wonder.
For now, let's head out\nto the main road.
// Background: Hinamizawa (day)
Whoa, talk about the boonies!
Mmm, delicious.\nYou can tell the air itself has flavor.
Wait! Everyone stop!!
What's wrong, Aria?
Just do it! Rika! Where's Rika!?
Who's Rika?
What's wrong, Aria?\nThere's no one named Rika among us, you know?
Uh... huh?
Wasn't Usada's name Rika, nyo?
It's Usada Hikaru!!\nI mean, call me RabiiennRose!!
Still, there's nothing here.
The greenery's dazzling.
Usada, Laura, Charlotte-\nyou're all here, right?
What are you talking about?\nOf course we're here.
Yeah... but isn't someone missing?
Who do you mean, "someone"?
What's wrong?
What's wrong?\nYou're acting weird, Aria.
(She's gone...\nsomeone's definitely missing...!)
(Am I the only one feeling this wrongness?\nAnd I'm forgetting something too...\nI know something, and I'm forgetting something!)
// Rika runs up
Aria! Good, I made it in time.
R-Rika? You're Rika, right?
Aria? Even your memories\nare fading?
Aria, what's wrong? Who's that?

Rem, sorry!
Keep everyone waiting a bit!
I've got something important
to discuss with her!
...Fine.
// Fade to black: passage of time\n// Background: forest (day)
Huh... time rewound...!?
Aria should remember.\nTomorrow is the day of the Watanagashi festival,\nand Aria has repeated this day several times.
Yeah... now that you mention it,\nit's coming back to me bit by bit.
I've died in this village of Hinamizawa before.\nAnd Rika and Satoko being killed too-\nugh...
Aria did her best.\nI remember all of it.
Rika, what are you?\nAnd what's happening in this village?
Something very sad...\nhappens, again and again.
That doesn't tell me anything!\nYou came back to do something about it, right?
...I want you to save Rena.
Rena?
Rena's acting strange.\nAt this rate, Rena will probably...
Die...?
Aria, don't you remember?\nClawing at her own throat until she dies.

It was me!
Driven mad by fear and suspicion,
losing my mind... I died in Hinamizawa!
And Rena's about to repeat it...?
Mii... there's nothing I can do.\nAria, I want you to see Rena.
Got it, where do I go?
Rena's doing something\nat the Hinamizawa branch school.\nYou should find her if you go.
The Hinamizawa branch school...\nyeah, I remember!
I'll take everyone\nto meet Mii and Satoko.
Hopefully that brings\neveryone's memories back.\nI'll leave that to you.
There's no time until\nthe Watanagashi festival.\nDo your best, Aria.
// Fade to black\n// Background: Hinamizawa (day)
The road to the Hinamizawa branch school\nwas, if I remember...
This way.
// Rena was behind Aria.
Rena!
(Damn! She's suspicious\nthat I know her name...!\nAll right then!)
You're Ryugu Rena, right?\nI'm Kanzaki H. Aria.\nDoes that name ring a bell?
...Don't think so?\nI wonderr
(Ugh... this feeling...!)
What's wrong?\nI wonderr

(Bad, she suspects me!
If my memory's right,
suspecting or being suspected is bad...
then!)
Rika from the Furude shrine\nasked me to come.\nShe wanted me to meet you.
Rika did?
Yeah.\nShe thought you might be troubled\nabout something.
I'm a Butei-I take requests\nfrom civilians and solve\ncrimes and problems.
Believe it or not, I'm a second-year\nin high school! Older than you!
Huh, so that's why you've got\nswords and stuff?
...You noticed when you stood behind me?
Yeah. Two of them.
Impressive.\nYou might not know me,\nbut the you I know is exactly like that.
Careful, thinking hard about what things are,\ntrying to find the answer. Right?
I'm surprised...\nwhy is that, when we just met?\nI wonderr
I'll tell you the truth.\nYou and I aren't meeting for the first time.\nMaybe you'll remember eventually?
I see...
So? Something's troubling you, right?\nFeel like telling me?
...Should we make a contract?\nI wonderr
You're hiring me as a Butei.\nFine, let's do that.
Butei Charter, Article Two:\nnever break a contract with a client.\nI will never betray you.
Then, before the contract,\nI'll tell you the request.
Quick to understand-that helps.\nThere are some requests I can't take,\nafter all.
The request is...
// Fade to black: passage of time\n// Background: Hinamizawa
You're... serious about all of that?

Yes. The curse of Oyashiro-sama-
'Demoning Away'-is carried out
by a fanatical faction to revive
faith in Oyashiro-sama.
And the ringleader is the Sonozaki family-\nMion's family?

Yes. 'Demoning Away' eliminates
inconvenient people to hide
Oyashiro-sama's secret-its true nature.
And they use it to strengthen the faith too.
Hide Oyashiro-sama's true nature?\nYou know what it is, Rena?
Oyashiro-sama...\nthe god enshrined in Hinamizawa.\nBut Oyashiro-sama's true nature isn't a god.
The true nature of Oyashiro-sama's curse\nwas a parasite... a virus that welled up\nfrom Onigafuchi Swamp.
A virus...?

A strange parasite that makes
the infected violent.
The infected became demons
and attacked people.
And Oyashiro-sama was the one\nwho cured it by some means.
So Oyashiro-sama was a doctor or something,\nwho became an object of faith?
If what you're saying is true,\nand it were made public,\nfaith in Oyashiro-sama would collapse.

That's why the fanatical faction carries out
'Demoning Away' every year to strengthen
faith in Oyashiro-sama, eliminating
those in the way.
(Eliminating those in the way...?\nReally...? Were Satoko and Rika in the way?\nAnd I wasn't murdered, I killed myself...?)
Someone's been watching me\nfor the past few days.\nI think it's probably the Sonozaki family.
The Sonozaki family...

So I told the police about the three notebooks
with the truth written in them,
and demanded a thorough search
of the Sonozaki family.

(The Sonozaki family...
Mion and Shion.
I can't believe they'd be involved
in 'Demoning Away')
(Still, if they were driven mad\nby the parasite Rena talks about,\nthe atrocities would make sense...)
(But something about what Rena just said\nfeels wrong. What it is...\nI don't know)
Then, I'll give you your first job,\nMiss Butei.
Sure, what should I do?
First...
// Fade to black\n// Background: Hinamizawa branch school (evening - match to battle map; night if evening unavailable)
This is it!\nWhere Aria's barricaded herself!
She's taken hostages\nand is holed up in that building, apparently.
Honestly, what is Aria doing!!
Can't we storm in?
In there are Dejiko, Siesta,\nplus Hinamizawa's Rika, Satoko,\nMion, and Shion, held hostage.
And Aria's accomplice is apparently\na girl named Rena Ryugu.

Rena Ryugu is demanding the police
forcibly search the Sonozaki family
within 24 hours, threatening to blow up
the building if they don't.
Same trick as a bank robber, nyu.
I trust Aria, but I can't grasp\nthe situation at all-\nI don't know how to move...!
Rika told me.\nThat Rena is a good girl.
So surely Aria and Rena\nare doing something meaningful.\nThat's what I believe.
Shirayuki, can you tell that kind of thing\nwith like, spiritual senses?
No, it's less a special power and more...\nempathy between those who carry shrines,\nI guess? Sorry, you wouldn't get it.
Hmm, that's deep.\nBut if you say so, Shirayuki,\nI'll believe it too!
Thank you, Koto.
Still, this is troublingg.\nHow can we get them\nto release the hostages?

Based on Rena's petition, the police
negotiated directly with the Sonozaki family
and concluded they're not behind
'Demoning Away'.
So the police won't act?
That's how it is...
// Battle map: Hinamizawa branch school (plains if unavailable?)\n// Rena and Aria barricade themselves with hostages Mion & Shion, Rika & Satoko, and Dejiko. Outdoors if no building.
What are the police doing!\nWon't they raid the Sonozaki family!!
Calm down, Rena!\nGetting worked up won't help.
I'm out of time!
Huh...
There's something I haven't told you yet,\nAria. Let me tell you.
The truth is,\nthe parasites are actually aliens.
Aliens...!?

They've controlled human bodies
through parasitism.
But sharp humans noticed,
and tried to expose the truth.
They eliminate sharp humans\nand create copies, making it look\nlike they're still alive.
(What is she saying...\nisn't this too much of a leap...?)
I'm one of those sharp humans.\nSo the parasites will eliminate me.\nBy tonight I'll claw at my throat and die.
(Just like me...!\nJust like that time, the first time I met Rena!\nDriven mad, clawing at her throat, dying!)

Before then, I have to destroy
Oyashiro-sama's fanatics-
the Sonozaki family.
You understand, right?
Our contract is for your protection, Rena!\nI can't help with anything beyond that!
No, you'll help.\nOr I'll blow this place up with the hostages\nand die right now!
(Tch... was it already too late?\nRika...!)
Aria... this is...
Rika, be quiet!\nHostages who don't stay quiet\nend up like Mii over there?
Rena... why are you doing this?
Shut up! You Sonozaki!
I mean, why am I captured, nyoo?
Aria asked me to come to the school with her,\nand then Rena ended up like this...
Can't you hear me telling you to shut up!\nI could tape your mouth shut, you know?\nIf being tied up isn't enough for you.
If the police don't move, you die!\nJust wait quietly.\nHaah-ha-ha-ha!!
(Rena's thinking is all over the place...!\nThe biggest problem right now is that Rena herself\nwill die soon because of the parasite...)
(Rena herself is consumed by hatred\nfor the Sonozaki family and by exposing\nHinamizawa's secret, true or not)
(What can I do... to save them?\nThe hostages... Rena...!)
// Enemy grunts appear around Rena and Aria. The grunts are positioned facing outward, as if protecting Rena's group.
Huh!? What are these!? Rena!!
Haah-ha-ha-ha!!\nThese guys are on my side too?\nGreat! Come on, protect me!
Rena! These guys are different!
You're the odd one out, Aria...?
Huh...
We made a contract, right?\nYou'll protect me, right?\nYou won't betray me, right?
...Yes. I always honor a contract\nwith a client.\nSo don't do anything rash, Rena.
Obviously.\nIf I blow this place up, the police won't move.\nI need them to do their jobs!

(At the very least, unless we eliminate
the enemy encirclement, we can't get
the hostages out...!
Everyone, I'm counting on you!)
// Player deployment
To think they'd show up\nat a time like this!
With those things around,\nwe can't save anyone!
Leave what's inside to Aria-\nlet's give all the support we can!
Something's coming...\nthose are Aria's friends, right?
Yeah.\nLooks like they came to deal\nwith the nuisances.
Those are protecting me, you know?
With those around, the police won't move.\nIt's interference by someone who'd be troubled\nif the police acted!
...Huh, I didn't call them,\nso maybe you're right.
But if they try to get in my way\neven a little, you know what happens, right?
I wish I could tell them that myself,\nbut there's no way to.
(Something's bound to come up\nduring the battle.\nIf I can seize it...!)
// Event when a set number of grunts are defeated
Huh, Aria's friends are strong.
You've fought alongside them before, Rena.\nDon't you remember?
I don't know them.\nI have no memory of people like that\nin Hinamizawa.
This isn't our first meeting here.\nYou went to Akihabara, as I recall.
Akihabara? What's that?
A town full of those.
Nyo?
Those... live there?
Yeah, lots of cute ones.\nDon't you remember Dejiko?
Dejiko... cute...?
S-someone take me home\nfrom here, nyo...
(Rena... you're not completely\ndelirious yet...)
(I need to find a way to fix this.\nFirst, securing the hostages' safety...)
// Event when more grunts are defeated
Aria's friends are amazing.\nBut... you're not asking them for help\nto get in my way, are you?
I said I'd honor the contract.

The contract is to protect me.
You're not thinking of stopping the bombing
and calling that 'protection'?
I wonderr
I'm bad at deduction.\nA slick solution like that's beyond me.\nBut I don't want to die here with you either.
Then what'll you do?
I'm thinking about that right now.\nWhat would you do, Rena?
Ah-ha-ha-ha!\nYou're asking the culprit\nto think of a solution?
What are you talking about?\nRena's in my club,\nand she's one of my partners.
Huh?
She's under contract with me, too.\nShe's no culprit.
Of course we'd figure out\nthe best move together.
What do you mean, I wonderr?
Listen, Rena - and Rika, you too.\nI've been thinking about what I've been doing wrong,\nand watching you like this, Rena… I think I finally get it.
Huh…?
Going it alone doesn't work.\nIt's my own personal issue too, but…\nyou can't shoulder your problems all by yourself.
You understand, don't you, Rika?\nEver since I met you that second time,\nI've managed to stay mostly sane.
Ah…!
So, Rena. I'll stay by your side,\nright to the very end.\nI'm your ally, okay?
…Aria.
(I was right to choose Aria, after all.\nShe's getting closer to the right answer…\nlittle by little.)
//Trigger the event by defeating more grunts
Hey, Rena. Where did you plant the bombs?
Bombs?
This place is thick with vaporized gasoline.\nYou've probably got a lighter or something -\nsomething to set it off, right?
But you'd have a backup plan, too.\nYou've planted a detonator somewhere, haven't you?\nRemote-controlled, or on a timer.
As expected of a Butei. Right on the money.
I'm no good at deductions,\nso I can't figure out where it is.
Can't tell you.\nYou'd just go stop it, wouldn't you?
I'll wait until the last possible moment.\nBut if you can't take it anymore, Rena,\nyou should at least let the hostages go.
No!!
Scared of being alone?\nDon't worry, I'm not running.\nI'll stay with you the whole time.
That's a lie! Lies, lies, all lies!!
Don't underestimate me!!
You think I'd call myself your ally\nwith some half-baked resolve like that?
Like I'd fall for that!
Did you forget? Rika asked me to help you\nbecause you were in trouble,\nand that's why I contracted with you.
I'll say it as many times as it takes.\nI'm here to save you, Rena.\nThat's my one and only reason.
That's a lie!!
Why can't you believe me?
Uuugh!! M-my head…!!
Rena!
Stay back!
AH-HAHAHAHA!! Trust a total stranger\nI met just today?\nWhat kind of idiot would do THAT!
Calm down! Don't lose to some parasite\nor whatever it is!
The police aren't going to move anyway!\nEnough - I'll end this myself!!
//SE: lighter lid opening
A lighter!?
//Rika runs in and tackles her //SE: tackle
Hiyah!!
Guh!?
//Rena collapses
The lighter! Got it!!\nSatoko! Shion! Get Mion out of here!!
Yes!
Will she be all right,\nnyo?
You go too, Aria!\nProtect everyone from the enemies outside!
Rika! You…!

This isn't the first time.
Last time, if only I'd tried
a little harder…!
So this time-!!
…Got it!
//Shion & Mion, Satoko, Dejiko, and Aria relocate (hide once, re-place at destination; adjust if only one of Satoko/Rika's units is visually available)
Aria's out! Looks like the hostages are with her!!
Everyone! Get somewhere safe, quick!\nI have to go right back!
And what are YOU gonna do!?
There's still someone I have to save!
That's so mean, Aria…\nYou said you'd stay by my side…
Rika-chan's gonna get killed, you know?\nAngry Rena will definitely kill her!
I'll play with you in Aria's place…\nCome here, cleaver girl…!

The area around the building is clear!

Rena…
Why did you come back, Aria?
I told you, didn't I…\nI'd stay by your side to the very end.
You were fighting the aliens so desperately…\nIf humanity goes extinct now,\nit'll be all your fault.
Aliens, huh… I've been through enough\nto believe that much, but your theory\nstill sounds fishy to me.
Still, I'll believe you.\nThe club has its own special way\nof settling things like this, right?
Hehe… the winner is justice, right!
//Event art off
Exactly! I'll see this through with you\nto the very end,\nso bring it on!!

If I win, you'd better brace yourself!
If you win, what'll you do to me?
You'll be my slave, of course!\nI'll put that keen eye and razor-sharp\ndeduction of yours to work 24/7!!
Then we'll solve the mysteries of Hinamizawa -\nand every mystery in the world!\nTotal victory!
AH-HAHAHAHA!!\nBig talk, huh!
//Conversation event on the 2nd clash
You probably don't remember,\nbut you and I once had\na legendary showdown in the club.
Back then, I thought -\nI want a rematch like this someday!
…That match… the one that ended\nin a draw…?
Oh? You remember?\nTo me, that draw was as good as a loss!
AH-HAHAHAHA!!\nDon't hold it against me if you lose this time!
//Conversation event on the 3rd clash
Let me confirm once more!\nIf I win, you're my slave,\nand you're solving every mystery there is!
No way, boring stuff's out!\nAnd you'll have to get me cute clothes, too!
I'll get you the finest!\n…Now, next - what happens if YOU win!
Huh?
I called the whole alien invasion thing\nfishy before, but I'll believe all of it -\nthat included.
And even if you claw your own throat out and die,\nI'll watch over you to the very end.\nJust like I promised.
…Somehow, even if I win,\nthat sounds no fun.
W-what? After all that…!
I want the same as you, Aria.\nTravel together, solve mysteries,\nlaugh with everyone, fight together, and then…
Rena…!? Did you just say…\ntravel together…?
I don't know. But that's what I want.
I'll allow the change.\nBut we still have to settle this!
Obviously!
//Event when Aria defeats Rena
…Kill me. Settle this.
It's already settled.\nI'm sorry it came to this.
…Why… did it come to this?
I did such awful things to everyone…!\nI love everyone, I know I do…!\nI believed in them, I know I did…!
Rena…
I remember… you, Aria.\nWe met so many times. At first I couldn't trust you,\nbut something changed, and we became friends.
We traveled together, played together, fought together -\nand I forgot it all, and I…!
It's okay. I was the same.\nIf I hadn't met Rika, I might have ended up\njust like you are now.
You can't do it alone.\nYou can't see your own mistakes that way.
…It doesn't suit me to say stuff like this, though.
Aria…! BWAAAHHH!!
(Rena… she remembered too.\nOne more soul heading out of\nthe never-ending June…)
